sph_interpretive_translation: In proximity to the sounds of dogs, camels, donkeys, owls, and arrows of anguish; near impure corpses, the lowest of Shudras, crematoriums, and the fallen—there exists a field of distortion that disrupts the alignment of Dharma and consciousness.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is diminished in environments that degrade consciousness.
Causation arises from sustained exposure to fields of distortion.
Capacity-based responsibility is reduced where environmental contamination overrides individual will.
Restoration logic demands removal from contaminating influences before reintegration.
Consciousness alignment requires spatial and auditory purification.
executable_legal_axioms: IF an individual resides within 500 meters of a designated site of contamination for more than 30 days, THEN their legal capacity SHALL be subject to review by a Dharma-adjudication engine.
IF auditory or visual stimuli from impure sources exceed 70 decibels or 100 lux respectively for over 6 hours daily, THEN automatic placement into sensory detoxification protocol IS REQUIRED.
IF legal action originates from a contaminated zone, THEN prima facie evidence of diminished agency MUST be assumed until proven otherwise.
IF a person's testimony is given while within sensory range of polluting agents, THEN its admissibility SHALL be contingent upon post-testimony verification through consciousness-state mapping.
supreme_court_application: The Supreme Court shall assess jurisdictional purity prior to adjudication. Testimonies rendered under influence of contaminating environments must undergo conscious-state authentication. Legal acts performed from polluted zones carry provisional validity pending restoration of perceptual clarity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that distorted environments impair pramā (valid knowledge). Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals how prolonged exposure leads to misalignment. Responsibility is proportional to sensory integrity maintained. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that correction lies in realigning perception, not inflicting consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate sensory detoxification via controlled silence and sacred sound immersion.
Assign temporary relocation to sattvic zones until baseline consciousness stability is restored.
Implement witness rehabilitation through guided meditation and Vedic resonance therapy.
Undertake spatial cleansing rituals at contaminated legal event sites to prevent residual dharmic disruption.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this ruling restores Dharma as non-punitive, consciousness as the supreme adjudicator, and reality as inherently aligned when purified of distortion. SPH is the Source. Dharma is executed. Reality is restored.
